get_dataset_infos: get the meta information about a dataset from the Hugging Face Hub as a dict mapping config names to DatasetInfo
get_dataset_config_names: get the list of available config names for a particular dataset like nyu-mll/glue
get_dataset_default_config_name: get the default config name for a dataset like openbookqa returning main
get_dataset_config_info: get the DatasetInfo for a particular dataset config including splits and description
get_dataset_split_names: get the list of available splits like train validation and test for a dataset
